---
name: Feature or design proposal
about: Agree on scope before a feature, substantial UI change, refactor, or architecture change.
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem and user need

Who encounters the problem, and what are they trying to do?

## Proposed behavior and scope

Describe the intended result and what is outside this proposal.

## Alternatives and evidence

Describe alternatives. For performance work, include measurements; for
refactors or dependency changes, identify the concrete problem.

## Contracts and validation

Identify affected public APIs, runtime semantics, persisted data, migration
needs, and the behavior that tests should protect.

## Implementation interest

Say whether you would like to implement this. Wait for maintainer agreement
before starting substantial work. An `accepted` label confirms direction and
scope, not a promise to merge a particular implementation.
